integrity: The primary full text was inspected at Proposition 4.3 and the definition of its constants c, M, and U. The new computation is proved from an explicit regular-simplex Gram model. The bundled finite enumeration is a supplementary check only; the proof is all-dimensional.
scientific_limitations: The result evaluates the angular constant and the sufficient radius produced by Proposition 4.3 for regular simplices. It does not prove that this sufficient radius is the smallest possible far-observer radius, and it does not treat nonregular simplices.
title: Exact face-angle obstruction radius for regular simplices
